title: TWiV 615: Peter Daszak of EcoHealth Alliance
summary: An episode of This Week in Virology in which Vincent Racaniello interviews Peter Daszak of EcoHealth Alliance about virus spillover, bats and wildlife sampling. It was recorded in 2020 during the early pandemic.
why: HN uses it mainly as a source in COVID origin debates, quoting what Daszak says about manipulating coronaviruses in the lab.
